item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: The world of metals and non-metals
item.stem:
Arjun tells his classmate Meera that only metals are useful in daily life because we see metal tools, wires, and machines everywhere. Meera disagrees and says non-metals are also essential.

Which example best supports Meera's argument that non-metals are essential in everyday life?

options.A: Steel spoons and aluminium utensils are used in the kitchen.
options.B: Copper wires carry electricity to fans and lights in homes.
options.C: Iron rods are used to build bridges and buildings.
options.D: Chlorine is used to purify drinking water, and nitrogen is used in fertilisers to help crops grow.
